description: Generates an AI image on the signed-in aicut account and puts the aicut card in front of the user. It waits for the image server-side for as long as one request safely can (about 24 seconds), so it usually returns the finished image with its `url` directly. WHEN: the user asks for an image; several different images: ONE call with `prompts`. Call `list_models` first if you have not this session (an unpublished combination is rejected). `get_recipe` `starter-image` has the first-image steps. CONSENT: a real person's picture only with their permission, never a public figure or celebrity. AFTER: `succeeded` is finished; `queued` or `processing` was not ready in time: `wait_for_generation` with the returned id and `media: "image"`. `count` above 1 or `prompts` answers at once with `jobs`: ONE `wait_for_generation` with their `ids`; give every url. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card with the result: say one line, never its `url` (no card? give it); no `show_generation`. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), never timers or background shells. TIMING: an image usually finishes in under 90 seconds and can take up to about 4 minutes; this call waits about 24 seconds for it itself. COST: this spends the user's tokens. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_cost`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's published `aspect_ratios` (for example `9:16`).

background.description: `transparent` gives a PNG with alpha. Only `gpt-image-2.5` and `gpt-image-2.6` take it; other models refuse it.

count.description: Images of this prompt, 1-4 (default 1), each its own job and price. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

images.description: Input image URLs to edit or use as references, on the models that accept them: public https URLs (aicut fetches and stores them) or earlier generations' URLs on this account.

max_tokens.description: The quote's `estimated_tokens`; above it the create is refused, not charged.

model.description: Model id exactly as `list_models` returns it (for example `gpt-image-2.5`). The user's pick, else the one `list_models` marks `recommended`; never a cheaper one to save them tokens.

prompt.description: What the image should show. The model's `prompt` parameter in `list_models` gives its character limit.

prompts.description: 2-4 different prompts, one image each, in place of `prompt` and `count`.

quality.description: Quality tier, on the models that publish a `quality` parameter; higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

resolution.description: One of the model's published options (for example `1k`); higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

studio_run_id.description: The open studio run's `run_id`; null = outside it; covered only under its run ticket, else its own priced ask.

variant.description: One of the model's published `variant` options (gpt-image-2.5 and 2.6: `flare`, the default, or `sunburst`); same price.

wait.description: `false` returns the job id at once (no wait of about 24 seconds): for several images, start them all, then ONE `wait_for_generation` with `ids`. Default true.

name: generate_image
title: Generate an AI image
